pages.title: The Cursed Cleaver
pages.text: Deep within Nether Bastion treasure vaults lies the $(4)Cursed Cleaver$(0)—a jagged, bloodstained tool left by ancient butcher demons.$(br2)Awakening the demon bound within requires a sacrificial rite of sculk and extreme spiritual energy.

pages.title: Summoning Ritual
pages.text: 1. Place an $(8)Anvil$(0) directly atop a $(3)Sculk Catalyst$(0).$(br)2. Accumulate at least $(2)30 XP Levels$(0).$(br)3. Right-click the anvil with the $(4)Cursed Cleaver$(0).$(br2)The anvil shatters in a violent sculk detonation, draining all levels and summoning $(4)The Carver$(0).

pages.title: Battle & Dark Relics
pages.text: Beware $(4)The Carver$(0)'s relentless pursuit and barbed $(4)Meat Hook$(0) which drags prey from afar.$(br2)Slaying him yields the $(c)Flayed Demon Heart$(0) and $(8)Bloodied Iron Hook$(0).$(br2)Transmute with $(8)Dark Sword (Base)$(0) to forge $(4)Night Sword$(0) and $(5)Dark Sword$(0)!
